assertion.interpretation: He repeatedly defeated Shi Hu, who thereafter dared not again look toward Henan — a later outcome of his campaigns following the crossing.

assertion.exact_span: 會其病卒先有妖星見豫州分逖曰此必爲我也天未欲滅寇故耳贈車騎將軍
assertion.interpretation: He fell ill and died; beforehand an ominous star appeared in the Yuzhou division, and he said it must be for him — a later outcome including his death and posthumous title.
